newsitem.title: JAPAN: Important for forex rates to be stable-MOF's Ogawa.
newsitem.headline: Important for forex rates to be stable-MOF's Ogawa.

text.p: It is important for foreign exchange rates to move in a stable manner and reflect economic fundamentals, Japan's Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa said on Monday.

Asked about earlier comments by Japan's trade minister that neither a weaker nor a stronger yen is desirable, Ogawa told a news conference: "I don't have any comments in particular. It is important that exchange rates move in a stable manner and reflect economic fundamentals."
Minister of International Trade and Industry Shinji Sato had said: "Our position is that neither a further appreciation nor a depreciation of the yen is desirable."

Sato added that although the currency issue was not expected to top the agenda at the Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations' summit meeting from June 20-22, the issue was likely to be raised during bilateral talks with the United States.
